text: 2026年9月14日，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能会见伦敦证券交易所集团富时罗素首席执行官菲奥娜·巴塞特，双方围绕当前国际金融市场趋势、中国金融市场高水平对外开放及富时罗素在华展业等议题进行了深入交流。
text_en: On September 14, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng met with Fiona Bassett, CEO of FTSE Russell under London Stock Exchange Group. The two sides held in-depth exchanges on topics including current international financial market trends, the high-level opening-up of China's financial market, and FTSE Russell's business development in China.
